entities.name: Asaf Jah VI of Hyderabad
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Asaf Jah VI, also known as Sir Mir Mahboob Ali Khan Siddiqi, was the sixth Nizam of Hyderabad. He ruled Hyderabad State, one of the princely states of India, between 1869 and 1911.
